title: [VSC-28] VS Code docs sweep for the follow-up wave (VSC-23, VSC-25, VSC-27)
description:
Filed by architect-d54b05fd while planning VSC-23 (task-921ca494). None of the code plans for VSC-23, VSC-25 or VSC-27 edits docs. VSC-24's plan carries its own CHANGELOG and MANUAL_TESTS entries, and VSC-26 is JetBrains-only.

Objective: once the follow-up rows land, moe-vscode's docs must stop describing the limits those rows fixed. VSC-18 (DONE, 78642f85) wrote these lines on purpose, as the open follow-ups:
- moe-vscode/README.md "Known issues", three lines:
  - "The task detail panel's Delivery section and Release Agent button show the task as it was when the panel opened; reopen the panel to refresh them" (VSC-23);
  - "While disconnected, the Claude accounts view lists no accounts, so a CLI-only sign-in is not offered (the JetBrains Accounts tab still offers it)" (VSC-25);
  - "On Windows, agent and account terminals expect PowerShell as the default terminal profile" (VSC-27).
- moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md "Task detail: Delivery and Release Agent" step 6: "Known limit (row VSC-23): ...".
- moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] has no entries for VSC-23, VSC-25 or VSC-27.
- docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md "Follow-ups filed during the epic" lists VSC-23 to VSC-27 with their status when written (PLANNING).

Deliverable:
- Each README line is removed, or rewritten to the narrower limit the row actually shipped. Read each row's completion diff first; never assume.
- MANUAL_TESTS.md step 6 becomes a live-refresh check (with the panel open, a change to the task's delivery evidence or assigned agent shows without reopening). Add a manual step for VSC-25's disconnected accounts rows and CLI sign-in, and one for VSC-27's non-PowerShell default terminal profile.
- One CHANGELOG [Unreleased] bullet each for VSC-23, VSC-25 and VSC-27. Keep VSC-24's entry as it landed.
- The reuse doc's follow-up table shows each of VSC-23 to VSC-27 with its final status and its landing commit.

NOT in scope: any code or test file, JetBrains docs, the epic rails' avoid list (CLAUDE.md, docs/roles/**, docs/MCP_SERVER.md, docs/SCHEMA.md and the rest), and re-designating the epic's final task.

Promote this row to PLANNING only after its dependsOn rows are DONE: its plan has to read what each of them shipped.

Verification command (run from the repo root):
! grep -nE "show the task as it was when the panel opened|lists no accounts, so a CLI-only sign-in is not offered|expect PowerShell as the default terminal profile" moe-vscode/README.md && ! grep -n "Known limit (row VSC-23)" moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md
If a row only narrowed its limit, replace the first grep's pattern for that line with one for the rewritten text, and quote both in the completion summary.
definitionOfDone: moe-vscode/README.md Known issues no longer carries the VSC-23, VSC-25 or VSC-27 sentence quoted in the description. Each one is removed, or rewritten to the narrower limit that row's completion diff shows, and the completion summary names which and why.

moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md no longer contains "Known limit (row VSC-23)". The Delivery and Release Agent section gains a numbered live-refresh step, and there is one numbered manual step each for VSC-25 (disconnected accounts rows, CLI sign-in) and VSC-27 (a non-PowerShell default terminal profile on Windows).
moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] has one bullet each describing the user-visible fix of VSC-23, VSC-25 and VSC-27, and VSC-24's own entry is unchanged.

The "Follow-ups filed during the epic" table in docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md shows VSC-23 to VSC-27 with their final status and a landing commit sha. `git log --grep 'Moe-Task: <id>'` finds each sha.

The completion commit changes only moe-vscode/README.md, moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md, moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md and docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md (check with git show --stat), and the description's verification command exits 0.

- The wip commits after them are post-QA board checkpoints, not the landing: 105bff1f, e5f61abe, 7473f31f and ff7247f3.
- Read the VSC-23, VSC-25 and VSC-27 completion diffs before you write anything (`git show <sha>`). Here is the planner's reading of each:

  - VSC-25 (fb0b5ab9): AccountsTreeProvider.parts() lists the latest rotation whatever the connection.
    - AccountPresentation.actions keeps the command-line actions on while disconnected: signIn, signOut, signOutAndRemove and check.
    - It turns the list edits off: add, rename, moveUp, moveDown, removeOnly and switchAt.

That is the same rule as JetBrains AccountsPanel.render (AccountsPanel.kt:177-178), so the remaining no-rotation case is shared with JetBrains rather than a VS Code known issue. Remove the README line.
  - VSC-27 (b86c9077): both createTerminal sites (AgentLauncher.launchAgent and AccountsTreeProvider.runCli) pass shellPath 'powershell.exe' on win32. Remove the README line.
  If a diff shows otherwise, rewrite that line to the narrower limit instead of deleting it. Change the matching marker in step 4's command, and say so in the summary.

implementationPlan.description:
2. moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md: one live-refresh step, one disconnected-accounts step and one Windows-terminal step. Edit tool only.

(a) In ## Task detail: Delivery and Release Agent, replace the whole line `6. Known limit (row VSC-23): the Delivery section and the button reflect the task as of panel open. Reopen the panel after a change.` with:
6. Keep the panel open while the task changes: a check run or receipt is recorded, the delivery evidence is cleared, an agent claims the task, or it is released from the board. Expected: the Delivery section and the **Release Agent** button update in place without reopening the panel. The section disappears when the task has no delivery evidence, and the button disappears when no worker is assigned.

(b) In ## Claude accounts view, replace the whole line `3. Disconnect. Expected: the view shows a single "Not connected to the Moe daemon." item, not stale rows. Reconnect, and the rows return.` with:
3. Disconnect. Expected: the rows and the chips line stay, from the last rotation the view received. **Sign in** still runs the accounts CLI `login <id>` in the "Claude accounts" terminal, and **Remove...** offers only **Sign out and remove**. **Add...**, **Rename...**, **Move up**, **Move down** and **Set Switch Percent...** are not offered. Reconnect, and the list edits return. A window opened while the daemon is down has no rotation yet, so it shows the single "Not connected to the Moe daemon." item.
The old step 3 ('not stale rows') contradicts VSC-25, so it is rewritten rather than kept beside the new one. Check the action names against package.json's command titles and AccountsTreeProvider.remove(): it offers only the choices that `allowed` enables.

(c) Add this new section directly before `## Remote-WSL (VS Code's answer to JetBrains' "Run Agents in WSL")`, with one blank line after it as between the other sections:
## Windows terminals use Windows PowerShell
1. On native Windows (not Remote-WSL), set `terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.windows` to **Command Prompt** or **Git Bash**. Run `Moe: Start Agent` → worker, and **Sign in** on an account in the **Claude accounts** view. Expected: both terminals open in Windows PowerShell whatever the default profile: the agent terminal runs the `-EncodedCommand` line and its seat registers, and the "Claude accounts" terminal runs the accounts CLI line.

Keep every other line and the numbering of the edited sections as they are.

error handling: same as step 1. A missing or non-unique anchor stops the edit; re-read, never guess.

test: the MANUAL_TESTS part of step 4's command passes. That covers `! grep -n "Known limit (row VSC-23)"` plus the 'without reopening the panel', 'last rotation the view received' and 'defaultProfile.windows' markers.

- It includes the description's two greps unchanged: the three README sentences are gone, and "Known limit (row VSC-23)" is gone.

(1) `git diff -U0 HEAD -- moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md | grep '^-[^-]'` prints nothing. The CHANGELOG only gained lines, so VSC-24's entry is unchanged (DoD 3).
(2) `git diff --stat HEAD -- moe-vscode/README.md moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md` shows your four files, and you edited no other file. The shared checkout may list peers' files in `git status`; those are not yours.
(3) Every claim in the new text matches the diff it rests on. Re-read the VSC-23, VSC-25 and VSC-27 hunks against your CHANGELOG bullets and manual steps: action names, the 'Not connected' text and powershell.exe.
(4) The Markdown still renders: list numbering in the two edited sections is unchanged, the new section has a heading and a numbered step, and each of the five table rows keeps its six cells.

Then call complete_task:
- verification: step 4's command, with its command, exitCode and outputTail.

- summary, which must state:
  (a) for each README line, removed or rewritten, and why. VSC-23 is fully fixed. VSC-25's remaining no-rotation case matches JetBrains AccountsPanel.render. VSC-27 uses shellPath powershell.exe at both terminal sites.
  (b) the three manual steps;
  (c) the three CHANGELOG bullets;

  (e) the exit code of the description's command.

The wrapper also lands this task's own .moe/tasks/task-7ad17dac9cf940e1907135d61f318c08.json as a BOARD path. That is the board record, not a docs change. Say so in the summary, so that QA checks DoD 5 with `git show --stat <completion> -- ':!.moe'`.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Each README line was weighed: remove it, or rewrite it to a narrower limit.
- VSC-23: no limit remains.
- VSC-27: shellPath powershell.exe is set at both createTerminal sites.
- VSC-25: one case remains: no rotation received yet, so the view shows Not connected. That is the same rule as JetBrains AccountsPanel.render (hasState && connected gives unsupported, else not connected), so it is parity, not a VS Code known issue.
All three lines are therefore removed.
